metadata.description: GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 4bpw on two DGX Sparks with MiaAI-Lab's E3 grouped fat-expert kernel, TP2 DFlash2, replay-safe hybrid APC, optional per-group retention, image input, and 850,000-token context
metadata.hardware: 2x NVIDIA DGX Spark or compatible GB10 systems
notes: The main mirror is pinned to 024db9f7e9871e8efdf21538ba55af7442be3cd5; its serving payload is byte-identical to the prior 25a44fdb snapshot and brandonmusic snapshot 5ab363a8. The DFlash2 draft payload selected by source revision 3f2be18 is independently pinned to dc77ff1c99eeb2df044ee3d4f0094eb033fee410.

The pinned public arm64 exl3-instanttensor image supplies InstantTensor 0.2.0 and compiled E3 grouped fat-expert symbols. Exact fffe64fc runtime overlays are checksum-pinned in the adjacent AGPL-3.0 mod and applied on both ranks. The public image predates optional thin-decode compiled kernels; those require a separately qualified rebuilt image, not a Python-only overlay. Thin decode, compact draft KV, cooperative MoE, dense FP8, adaptive verification, runtime ABLIT, and per-group sparse retention remain off.

The TP2 profile retains InstantTensor loading, an explicit 15032385536-byte (14 GiB) KV pool, GPU_MEM_UTIL=0.85, and 850,000-token context. The default mixed scheduler is fair v7. The 20260913 and 20260923 live evidence is historical and does not validate this refresh; fresh dual-rank live qualification is required. The prior 1M/E2 recipe remains unchanged for rollback.

DEFAULT_MAX_NEW_TOKENS=65536 changes only omitted-request output limits; explicit client limits still win subject to independent model/platform caps. Image processing uses max_image_tokens=2048 and a 1 GiB processor cache; video remains disabled locally. Cache-reset routes remain disabled.
GLM53_INDEXER_WORKSPACE=rightsize uses upstream's fail-closed legal-maximum workspace formula. Its exhaustive gate proves equivalent prefill chunking while returning memory to KV.

Local observability adaptations preserve worker environment with SPT_NOENV=1 and expose per-request APC cached-token counts with --enable-prompt-tokens-details; neither changes the selected model or scheduler profile.
Port 8000 deliberately preserves this registry's SparkRun, sparkDash, and LiteLLM convention; upstream uses 8888. The endpoint translation does not alter model execution or benchmark accounting.

SparkRun replaces upstream's fixed single-HCA interface names with per-host fabric detection. Validate every intended CX-7 path before launch; the serving profile and shared RoCE controls remain upstream-compatible.

SparkRun 0.3.6's optional post-hook lifecycle waits only 240 seconds for the API. This recipe defines no post_exec; rank 0 starts a fail-closed in-container gate with up to 720 API polls (5-second request timeout and 5-second sleeps), followed by separate warmup/semantic phases; the gate terminates vLLM on failure.
The DFlash2 checkpoint is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for research/evaluation. Review its license and the EXL3 checkpoint's ShapleyMCG License 1.0 before use.

The API is unauthenticated, root-user, host-networked, and LAN-only. Keep inference, distributed-runtime, NCCL, and proxy port `4000` on a trusted firewalled private network; all are untrusted-client boundaries. Remote media is restricted to the non-resolving media.invalid sentinel; inline image data URLs remain supported. The literal supported multimodal limit is image-only: {"image": 4, "video": 0}; release evidence must include exact direct and proxy rejection receipts for that zero-video boundary.

command:
export PATH="/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH:-}";
export GLM53_SERVE_PORT=8000;
export GLM53_SERVED_MODEL=GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3;
exec bash /workspace/mods/glm-5.3-flash-exl3-upstream-850k/serve_wrapper.sh /cache/huggingface/hub/models--Mia-AiLab--GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-TR3-4bpw/snapshots/024db9f7e9871e8efdf21538ba55af7442be3cd5 \
  --served-model-name GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --quantization exl3 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --load-format instanttensor \
  --kv-cache-memory-bytes 15032385536 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --max-model-len 850000 \
  --max-num-seqs 4 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 7168 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"/cache/huggingface/hub/models--incoai--GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2/snapshots/dc77ff1c99eeb2df044ee3d4f0094eb033fee410","num_speculative_tokens":7,"kv_cache_dtype":"auto","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"standard","draft_tensor_parallel_size":2}' \
  --cudagraph-capture-sizes 1 2 4 8 16 24 32 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --enable-prompt-tokens-details \
  --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \
  --tool-call-parser glm47 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --reasoning-parser glm45 \
  --chat-template /opt/glm53/chat_template.jinja \
  --allowed-media-domains media.invalid \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":4,"video":0}' \
  --mm-processor-kwargs '{"max_image_tokens":2048}' \
  --mm-processor-cache-gb 1 \
  --skip-mm-profiling
